principle: The civilization exists first; discovery changes knowledge and may force deterministic detail resolution without creating retroactive truth.

observed_low_detail.rule: Observation can be wrong/uncertain; world truth remains separate.

materialized_individuals.rule: Consume real population/institution slots through Tier C→B promotion.

rules: Materialization never changes previously observed facts unless the earlier observation was explicitly uncertain/wrong.
Unknown self-names remain unknown to the player even if internally materialized for deterministic persistence.
Materialization cannot increase population merely to provide NPCs.
Each generated sub-entity receives stable id and provenance.
Save/load and revisit never reroll materialized civilization detail.
A civilization can remain partially materialized indefinitely if gameplay never requires more detail.
